output.description: Output form. Left out of the digest.

output_dir.description: The output folder: must not lie inside the data folder or a git working tree.

plugins.description: Plugin file names in load order, masters first.

worlds.description: Worlds to generate (editor ids); empty means every world with terrain.

FullModelShapes.description: How far a full model is simplified into a far shape: it stops at whichever limit it reaches first.

keep.description: Share of each shape's triangles to keep, above 0 and at most 1.

max_error.description: Largest error allowed, as a share of the shape's size, from 0 to 1.

IncludeRule.description: One rule of `inclusion.include_rules`: which placed objects to take into object LOD.

generate.description:
Draw the objects this rule matches that have no LOD model with a simplified copy of their full model, at
these limits. Only the objects the rule matches get such a shape; other objects follow
`objects.shapes_from_full_models`. Not set by default; written only when set.

models.description:
The model path (relative to `meshes`, any case, either separator) as a pattern; `*` matches any run of
characters.

plugin.description: Only objects whose reference or base object comes from this plugin (file name, any case).

record_type.description: Only base objects of this record type: four capital letters or digits, such as `STAT`.

Inclusion.description: Which objects enter object LOD, beyond the game's own rule (visible when distant).

exclude_models.description:
Leave out models whose path (relative to `meshes`, lower case, forward slashes) matches one of these
patterns; `*` matches any run of characters.

exclude_plugins.description: Leave out objects whose reference or base object comes from one of these plugins (file names).

exclude_records.description: Leave out these records: absolute `FormID`s of a reference or a base object, eight hex digits.

include_rules.description:
Take objects that nothing marks visible from far into object LOD when they match one of these rules. Only
references that stand when the game starts (themselves and through their enable parent) are taken; the
exclusion rules above still win.
Empty by default and written only when set, so a request without rules keeps its digest.

only_plugins.description: When not empty, keep only objects whose reference or base object comes from one of these plugins.

diffuse_size.description: Edge of the diffuse map in pixels, a power of two from 4 to 4096.

max_vertices.description: Vertex cap per block mesh, 3 to 32767.

normal_size.description: Edge of the normal map in pixels, a power of two from 4 to 4096.

quality.description: Quality: the allowed vertical error is twice this many world units.

skirts.description:
Close the gap between neighbouring blocks with a skirt under every border vertex, as the game's own blocks
do (`docs/spec/terrain-lod.md`). On by default (without them the game shows the background through the cracks
between blocks of different levels); written only when off.

specular_alpha.description:
Carry specular in the alpha channel of the normal map, written as BC3 (own design, `docs/spec/textures.md`).
Off by default and written only when set; off keeps the normal map opaque BC1.

memory_mib.description: A memory budget in MiB, advisory: the run refuses early when the plugins alone are expected to need more.

threads.description: Worker threads; omitted means every core of the machine.

drop_under_terrain.description:
Leave out object faces that lie wholly under the ground (all three corners below the terrain at their
position). Off by default; written only when on.

drop_under_water.description:
Leave out object faces that lie wholly under the water of a cell that has water. Off by default; written
only when on.

far_lights.description:
Draw the steady lights that stand beside far objects as small unlit light points, one marked shape per object
block that the engine shows only at night. Off by default, because an engine without that night switch shows
them by day too; written only when on.

far_model_without_flag.description:
Also take references that nothing marks visible from far when their model has a far model
(`<model>_lod.nif`) and their base is not drawn as a tree billboard; only references that stand when the game
starts are taken. Off by default; written only when on.

shapes_from_full_models.description:
Draw objects that have no LOD model with a simplified copy of their full model. Off by default, because the
game's own LOD is the standard; written only when set.

OutputRequest.description: What the output folder holds when the run is done.

pack.description:
Pack the generated files into one BSA archive with a stub plugin of the same name instead of leaving them
loose. A step after the generation: it is not part of the request digest, so switching it rebuilds no
block. Off by default; written only when on.

ShippedShapeRule.description: One world's models whose far shape is taken from the far blocks the games ship.

models.description: Model paths relative to `meshes`, in any case and with either separator.

world.description: The worldspace's editor id, in any case. A world the load order does not have is ignored.

compose_shipped_tiles.description:
Compose every diffuse tile from the land textures, also where the game ships its own far-land tile and no plugin
outside the game's own masters changed the land under it (`docs/spec/terrain-lod.md`). Off by default: such a
tile is left out of the output and the game's own is the one drawn; written only when on.

drop_under_water.description:
Leave out terrain faces that cannot be seen under water: a face whose three corners all lie at least this many
world units below the water plane of the cell it is in (own design, `docs/spec/terrain-lod.md`). Absent by
default, which keeps every face; written only when set.

land_light.description:
Darken the composed far land as the near land is lit: each land texture's colours times the mean up component
of its normal map, and a game tile is used only where it is already that dark (`docs/spec/terrain-lod.md`).
On by default; off gives the output the generator wrote before this option existed. Written only when off.

land_textures.description: Blend the land textures into the diffuse maps (off: vertex colours only).

levels.description: Levels; empty means the defaults (4, 8, 16 and 32).

texture_scales.description:
How often a land texture repeats across a cell quadrant in the diffuse maps, by the land texture's absolute
`FormID` (eight hex digits); a texture not listed repeats once. Empty by default; written only when set.

water.description: Write water planes into the terrain blocks that have ground below water.

water_polygons.description:
Write the water planes of levels 8 to 32 as the polygons of the wet area's outline, corners only (fewer
vertices, the same ground covered); takes precedence over `water_shared_vertices`. Off by default; written
only when on.

water_shared_vertices.description:
Write a corner that two rectangles of the water plane have in common once, at levels 8 to 32 (fewer vertices,
the same planes). Off by default; written only when on.

water_walls.description:
Write the game's water borders: a wall on every block border where the water meets it, from the water down to
the height the game's outlines drop to, and at level 4 a plane that overlaps its neighbours by 32 units
(`docs/spec/terrain-lod.md`). On by default (without them the lake shows a pale band and a dotted line at every
block seam); written only when off.

enabled.description:
Write tree LOD: billboard atlas, type list and block files. Needs billboard textures that mods ship in
the data folder (see docs/spec/object-lod.md); a world without any gets no tree LOD.
